messages:
elaine (PM): Heads-up — ACME corp just pushed a hard requirement: per-tenant model pinning + a cold-start SLA (<=250ms tail) for their Dedicated deployment. They said v1 hinges on it. We need to decide scope impact for current milestone.
chris (ENG): Ack. That is a big one. Model pinning implies routing + version metadata + rollback hooks. Cold-start SLA is hard on Dedicated GPUs.
elaine (PM): Can we get an initial assessment today? ACME is on the fence about signing if we miss v1.
tara (ENG-PLATFORM): Quick thought: we can support model pinning via routing policy + tag on config (no change to runtime) — that’s low lift. The cold-start SLA is the blocker: requires pre-warmed pools and a warm-cache strategy.
mike (CS): ACME will pay for reserved capacity but they expect us to guarantee tail latency in contract. They asked for failure-mode behavior too (fallback to smaller model).
chris (ENG): Options I’m seeing:
- A (minimal): implement model pinning and best-effort warmers (no SLA). Ships in current milestone (~2 weeks).
- B (balanced): pinning + pre-warmed standby nodes + simple KV prefix cache for hot tenants => measurable tail improvement, SLA possible but needs Dedicated infra changes (~4–6 weeks).
- C (shippable SLA): full pre-provisioning, autoscale reservation windows, and fallback model orchestration (~8–10 weeks).
elaine (PM): ACME only accepts B or C. They asked for a tradeoff matrix and recommendation for execs by EOD.
nitesh (SRE): Note on B: we need a practial N for standby nodes per tenant. If ACME commits to a reserved pool (X GPUs), we can calculate. Otherwise risk of noisy neighbors.
tara (ENG-PLATFORM): I can prototype the routing+pinning in a day. The pre-warmed standby requires config plumbing: per-tenant pool configs, billing hooks, and a new pre-warm controller.
chris (ENG): Also telemetry: to validate the SLA we must export p95/p99 per-tenant token latency and cold-start markers. That’s additional work but lower lift.
mike (CS): I'll push ACME to commit to a 6-month reserved capacity (they hinted yes). That could make B feasible.
elaine (PM): Recommendation (my take): ship A to keep our milestone, but present B as a near-term paid upgrade with a firm timeline (4–6 weeks) and require reserved capacity contract. If ACME insists on SLA in the contract, we escalate to execs — B+contract gets us most of the way. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
chris (ENG): I’m ok with A->B path if contract locks reserved capacity. Otherwise we should not promise an SLA.
tara (ENG-PLATFORM): Agreed. I'll sketch the pre-warm controller design and a minimal per-tenant config model this afternoon.
nitesh (SRE): I'll run rough capacity calc for standby nodes assuming 99th percentile request bursts. Need ACME's expected qps and model size.
mike (CS): @elaine I'll get ACME estimates and try to secure the reservation language.
elaine (PM): Sweet. Action items: tara prototype routing/pinning PR (ETA EOD), chris surface telemetry gaps (ETA tomorrow), nitesh capacity calc (ETA tomorrow morning), mike get ACME commit (ETA EOD). I'll prepare the exec tradeoff memo based on outputs.
deploy-bot: deploy started: feature/route-pinning to staging at 1746252500 — CI green :white_check_mark:
chris (ENG): Noting risk: if we do A and then flip to B mid-rollout we must handle config migration and ensure no double-billing on reserved pools.
elaine (PM): Good catch. Add migration plan to the memo.
mike (CS): ACME replied — they can commit to a 3-node reserved pool initially, and want SLA language in contract if we can reach p99 <= 350ms (they lowered requirement). This changes numbers.
nitesh (SRE): 3 nodes may be borderline depending on model footprint. I'll run numbers with their qps. If footprint high, we must recommend 5 nodes or autoscale buffer.
tara (ENG-PLATFORM): Update: routing pinning prototype is done (PR open). It’s config-only; no runtime changes. I’ll link PR in thread.
elaine (PM): Thanks team. I’ll draft the tradeoff memo: propose A for milestone, conditional B once ACME signs reserved capacity (explicit node count), and timeline for full SLA (C) as separate paid project. Will share draft before EOD. :rocket:
